faqs.question: How accurate is the US Navy body fat method?
faqs.answer: The US Navy method has an error of ±3–4% compared to DEXA (gold standard). It's significantly more useful than BMI for fitness tracking.

faqs.question: What body fat percentage is considered healthy?
faqs.answer: For men: Athletic 6–13%, Fitness 14–17%, Average 18–24%. For women: Athletic 14–20%, Fitness 21–24%, Average 25–31%.
